signal: AcquireROI operates in the fast-growing virtual and hybrid events market, where partner and co-sell coverage at scale is a constant pain

email.subject1: a signal play for AcquireROI's partners
email.body1:
Ryan, with AcquireROI competing in a virtual-events market that keeps consolidating, partner coverage is getting harder to scale.

A growing ecosystem usually means more co-sell and partner targets in play than the team can personally cover, and that is where partner-sourced pipeline stalls. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own across the ecosystem, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for AcquireROI's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for AcquireROI.

As the partner base grows, co-sell intros get uneven and the best joint accounts go untouched. Most partnerships teams have no clean way to cover every target without adding bodies, and partner-sourced pipeline pays the price.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and our pipeline model, showing exactly how many partner-sourced meetings AcquireROI can drive this quarter without new hires.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for AcquireROI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AcquireROI's reply rate likely compares to similar teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and ramping a partner program is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays for your partner motion? I will tailor it to AcquireROI either way.
